import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MAXB = 60;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 2000000000000000000L;

    static void reduce(int[] x) {
        if (x[0] >= MOD) x[0] -= MOD;
        if (x[0] < 0) x[0] += MOD;
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] data;
        int size;

        Matrix(int n, int val) {
            size = n;
            data = new int[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = (i == j) ? val : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] getRow(int i) {
            return data[i];
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(size, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        long val = (long) data[i][k] * b.data[k][j] % MOD;
                        int[] temp = {res.data[i][j]};
                        reduce(temp);
                        res.data[i][j] = temp[0] + (int) val;
                        reduce(temp);
                        res.data[i][j] = temp[0];
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(size, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = data[i][j] + b.data[i][j];
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean equals(Matrix b) {
            if (size != b.size) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    if (data[i][j] != b.data[i][j]) return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    static Matrix powerMatrix(Matrix base, long exp) {
        Matrix res = new Matrix(base.size, 1);
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = res.multiply(base);
            }
            base = base.multiply(base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long get(long n, int lastIdx, long[] val, List<Matrix> a, List<Matrix> shift, int k) {
        if (n == 0) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(k + 1, 0);
            res.data[0][0] = 1;
            return matrixToLong(res);
        }
        long res = 0;
        long power = val[lastIdx];
        if (n >= power) {
            long times = n / power;
            n %= power;
            Matrix tmp = a[lastIdx];
            for (int i = 0; i < times; i++) {
                tmp = tmp.multiply(shift[k - 1]);
            }
            Matrix resMat = new Matrix(k + 1, 0);
            resMat.data[0][k] = 1;
            resMat = resMat.multiply(tmp);
            resMat = resMat.multiply(get(n, lastIdx - 1, val, a, shift, k));
            return matrixToLong(resMat);
        } else {
            return get(n, lastIdx - 1, val, a, shift, k);
        }
    }

    static long matrixToLong(Matrix m) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m.size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m.size; j++) {
                res += m.data[i][j];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        long[] val = new long[MAXB];
        Arrays.fill(val, 1);
        int lastIdx = MAXB - 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXB; i++) {
            if (val[i - 1] >= INF / k) {
                val[i] = INF;
                lastIdx = i;
                break;
            }
            val[i] = val[i - 1] * k;
        }

        List<Matrix> shift = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXB; i++) {
            shift.add(new Matrix(k + 1, 0));
        }

        shift.set(0, new Matrix(k + 1, 1));
        shift.set(1, new Matrix(k + 1, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            shift.get(1).data[i][(i - 1 + k) % k] = 1;
        }
        shift.get(1).data[k][k] = 1;

        for (int i = 2; i < k; i++) {
            shift.set(i, shift.get(i - 1).multiply(shift.get(1)));
        }

        List<Matrix> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXB; i++) {
            a.add(new Matrix(k + 1, 0));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            a.get(0).data[i][0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < lastIdx; i++) {
            Matrix tmp = a.get(i - 1);
            a.set(i, a.get(i - 1));
            for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
                a.set(i, a.get(i).multiply(shift.get(k - 1)).multiply(tmp));
            }
            a.set(i, a.get(i).multiply(shift.get(k - 1)));
        }

        Matrix answer = new Matrix(k + 1, 0);
        answer.data[0][k] = 1;
        long res = get(n, lastIdx - 1, val, a, shift, k);
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
